channel.title: PkgWatch: high-risk suspicious packages on npm and PyPI
channel.description: PkgWatch statically analyses newly published npm and PyPI packages and lists the ones that look suspicious. Entries are leads for human review, not verdicts.

item.title: [HIGH 84] suspicious pypi package: stacktrace-cli 0.27.0
item.description:
Risk score 84/100 (high).

  • Code reads credential, browser, chat-token or wallet files and also makes network calls in the same file.
  • Archive contains absolute or parent-directory paths and was not unpacked.
  • Missing or placeholder repository URL.

Registry page · Report a false positive

item.title: [HIGH 72] suspicious pypi package: pymeep 1.36.0
item.description:
Risk score 72/100 (high).

  • setup.py subprocess.run() starts a process at install time.
  • Recently created package from a publisher with little history, with a name similar to popular package 'pymeeus'.
  • setup.py class egg_info overrides the 'setuptools.command.egg_info.egg_info' command at install time.
  • Name is 2 edit(s) from popular package 'pymeeus' (two edits apart).

Registry page · Report a false positive

item.title: [HIGH 80] suspicious pypi package: pre-commit-bigfix 2.4.0
item.description:
Risk score 80/100 (high).

  • Code decodes or unpacks a hidden payload and executes it. (in 3 files)
  • Code downloads a file and then executes it or marks it executable.

Registry page · Report a false positive

item.title: [HIGH 100] suspicious pypi package: mcp-audit-scanner 0.34.0
item.description:
Risk score 100/100 (high).

  • Code decodes or unpacks a hidden payload and executes it.
  • Code serialises the whole process environment in a file that makes network calls.
  • Hardcoded Pipedream endpoint in package code.
